description: This file defines the User entity class for the insurance management system, including its fields, relationships, and mappings to the database table.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Entity representing a user within the system, with roles, account details, and associated activities.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to update the 'updatedAt' timestamp before saving changes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: getFullName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the user.

methods.name: setFullName
methods.description: Sets the full name of the user.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the user.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address of the user.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Returns the hashed password.

methods.name: setPasswordHash
methods.description: Sets the hashed password.

methods.name: getPhone
methods.description: Returns the user's phone contact, if any.

methods.name: setPhone
methods.description: Sets the user's phone contact.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the user account is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the user account.

methods.name: isLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the user account is locked.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Locks or unlocks the user account.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the user was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last update.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last updated timestamp.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Returns the set of roles assigned to the user.

methods.name: setRoles
methods.description: Assigns roles to the user.

methods.name: getCustomerPolicies
methods.description: Returns the set of customer policies associated with the user.

methods.name: setCustomerPolicies
methods.description: Sets the customer policies associated with the user.

methods.name: getClaimsCreated
methods.description: Returns the claims created by the user.

methods.name: setClaimsCreated
methods.description: Sets the claims created by the user.

methods.name: getClaimsAsCustomer
methods.description: Returns the claims where the user is the customer.

methods.name: setClaimsAsCustomer
methods.description: Sets claims where the user is the customer.

methods.name: getPayments
methods.description: Returns the payments made by the user.

methods.name: setPayments
methods.description: Sets the payments associated with the user.

methods.name: getAuditEntries
methods.description: Returns audit entries involving the user.

methods.name: setAuditEntries
methods.description: Sets audit entries involving the user.
